row.body: 2026-11-26: all 6 orchestrator runs failed with 'daily free neurons used' (8,123 spent vs an 8,000 default cap) on a Workers Paid account, and glm-4.7-flash replies with response '' were scored empty because textOf used ??. The code agent now has its own cap (AI_CODE_NEURONS_DAY, default 150000) and textOf takes the first non-empty field.
